title: Privacy Policy
disclaimer: The party responsible for this website is L+H MarketingServices GmbH.
intro: Protecting your privacy is very important to us. That's why we have generally designed our website so that it can be used as far as possible without processing your personal data.

1.title: Usage data
paragraphs: When you visit our website, so-called usage data is temporarily evaluated in a log on our web server for statistical purposes in order to improve the quality of our website. This data set consists of
- the name and address of the requested content,
- the date and time of the request,
- the amount of data transferred,
- the access status (content transferred, content not found),
- a description of the web browser and operating system used,
- the referral link showing which page you came from to reach ours,
- the IP address of the requesting computer, shortened so that it can no longer be linked to a specific person.
The log data mentioned above is only evaluated in anonymized form.

2.title: Storage of the IP address for security purposes
paragraphs: In addition, we store the full IP address transmitted by your web browser strictly for the purpose of detecting, limiting, and eliminating attacks on our website, for a period of seven days. After this period has elapsed, we delete or anonymize the IP address. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(1)(f) GDPR.

3.title: Data transfer to third parties
paragraphs: We do not transfer your personal data to third parties.

4.title: Encryption
paragraphs: To protect your data from unwanted access, we use an encryption process on all pages. Your requests and inputs are then transmitted between your computer and our server via the internet using TLS encryption. You can recognize this by the closed padlock symbol in your browser's status bar and by the address bar starting with https://.

5.title: Your rights as a user
paragraphs: When your personal data is processed, the GDPR grants you, as a website user, certain rights:
1. Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR):

You have the right to request confirmation as to whether personal data concerning you is being processed; if so, you have a right to access that personal data and the information listed in detail in Art. 15 GDPR.
2. Right to rectification and erasure (Art. 16 and 17 GDPR):

You have the right to request the immediate rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning you and, where applicable, the completion of incomplete personal data. You also have the right to request that personal data concerning you be erased without delay, provided one of the grounds listed in detail in Art. 17 GDPR applies, e.g. if the data is no longer needed for the purposes pursued.
3. Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR):
You have the right to request the restriction of processing where one of the conditions listed in Art. 18 GDPR applies, e.g. if you have objected to the processing, for the duration of any review.
4. Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR):

In certain cases, listed in detail in Art. 20 GDPR, you have the right to receive personal data concerning you in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format, or to request that this data be transferred to a third party.
5. Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR):

If data is collected on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) (data processing to safeguard legitimate interests), you have the right to object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to the processing. We will then no longer process the personal data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds for the processing which override your interests, rights, and freedoms, or the processing serves to assert, exercise, or defend legal claims.
6. Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority:

In accordance with Art. 77 GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of data concerning you violates data protection law. This right may be exercised in particular with a supervisory authority in the member state of your residence, place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement.
7. Data protection officer:

For further questions on data protection matters, please contact our external data protection officer by email at <linkTag href='mailto:office@datenschutz-sued.de'>office@datenschutz-sued.de</linkTag> or by phone at <linkTag href='tel:+499313049760'>+49/931 304 976 0</linkTag> (datenschutz süd GmbH, Wörthstraße 15, 97082 Würzburg, Germany).

6.title: Google Maps
paragraphs: On the 'Directions' page we embed a map view provided by Google Maps. The provider is Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland.

The map is not loaded automatically. Unless you expressly consent, you will only see a placeholder in its place, and no data whatsoever is transmitted to Google. Only when you click 'Consent and load map' is the map retrieved from Google's servers.

This retrieval transmits, in particular, your IP address as well as information about your browser, operating system and device to Google. Google may also forward this data to Google LLC in the USA and process it there; transfers to the USA are covered by an adequacy decision of the European Commission based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. If you are signed in to a Google account at the time of retrieval, Google may associate the access with your account. We have no influence over the scope, purpose or further processing of the data by Google.

The legal basis for the transfer is your consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(1)(a) GDPR. Your consent is not stored and applies solely to the current page visit. You may withdraw it at any time with effect for the future by reloading the page — the map will then be blocked again. The lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal remains unaffected.
For more information on how user data is handled, please see <linkTag href='https://policies.google.com/privacy'>Google's privacy policy</linkTag>.
